newsitem.title: USA: National Fuel withdraws from Pakistan plant.
newsitem.headline: National Fuel withdraws from Pakistan plant.

text.p: National Fuel Gas Co said on Friday its subsidiary, Horizon Energy Development Inc, decided to withdraw from the development of a 151-Megawatt power plant in Pakistan.
The company said although it made progress on the project in a short time, a large number of issues remained unresolved.

"Our determination to withdraw from participation in the project is based upon our conviction that the documentation required for a timely construction start cannot be accomplished in the time remaining," said Bruce Hale, Horizon's vice president.

The company said in an earlier release its equity investment in the $170 million gas-fired, combined cycle turbine facility was about $18 million with the remainder coming from Pakistan's Fauji Foundation and the Asian Development Bank.
